notes.title: Twinkle☆Guardians Ver 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852951/2292e5d2e35cad188264f064b75f1a8ac2513874.jpg[/img]

【new feature】
Added [View Hints] function to see examples of character placement.
You can see it optionally while paused.


【ステータス調整】
Angelica
ATK
LV1   17→18
LV2   33→34
LV3   46→48


【ステージ修正】
Stage 2 (shortened)
Stage 29, Stage 34, Stage 35 (increase in enemy HP due to waves was made more gradual)
Stage 21, 28 boss (big cat, caterpillar) HP increase

notes.title: Twinkle☆Guardians1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852951/cf76eae952f236e2446cbee66330c6b053bda7ea.png[/img]
【Update Details】

Fixed a bug that prevented enemies from appearing when they were supposed to.



It is difficult to reproduce the situation in which the bug occurred, and we have not been able to confirm that it has been completely fixed.

If you have a similar bug, it would be greatly appreciated if you could write about it on the bug report board.

notes.title: Twinkle_Guardians 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44852951/05cf5348bdb37c91acd3943a87cac11b44b199d2.png[/img]
[b]Update content: Minor difficulty reduction & bug fixes[/b]

Up to WAVE 5, the cost that increases when passing through WAVE has been increased from 50 to 80!

The initial cost for stages that already have characters is now the same as normal! 200→300

Changed the enemy appearance interval in some places（STAGE 1,7,20）


Fixed reported bugs
[When replaying some stages, enemies appear unexpectedly]
